本階段必須重驗：逐事件核對版本遞增與餘額 100→40，變更 100→40→10；名義不得產生 -20 或兩筆都成功但仍為 40；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.instructionEn:
Duplicate debits may arise from missing idempotency or from a stale-value retry. Transaction isolation and request deduplication are different contracts; satisfying one does not automatically satisfy the other. Inspect repeated transaction identities and read-version changes. Reconcile accepted unique debits with final balance, distinguishing replayed acknowledgments from genuinely new committed operations.
Against the nominal DAOS transactions: construct traceable inputs and ownership result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Require nonnegative balance, version consistency, conservation of unique accepted debits and idempotent redelivery. The fixture explains concepts and does not implement the complete DAOS transaction protocol.
Reverify this criterion: Replay events and verify 100→40 nominally and 100→40→10 after the change. Reject both a negative balance and the lost-update history where two successful 60-unit debits leave 40. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。重複扣款可能是缺少冪等鍵，也可能是衝突重試沿用舊值；交易隔離與請求去重是不同契約；檢查相同 transaction_id 的回應是否重放、版本是否更新；對照帳本總扣款與最終餘額守恆。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Duplicate debits may arise from missing idempotency or from a stale-value retry. Transaction isolation and request deduplication are different contracts; satisfying one does not automatically satisfy the other. Inspect repeated transaction identities and read-version changes. Reconcile accepted unique debits with final balance, distinguishing replayed acknowledgments from genuinely new committed operations.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 逐事件核對版本遞增與餘額 100→40，變更 100→40→10；名義不得產生 -20 或兩筆都成功但仍為 40；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.checkEn: Replay events and verify 100→40 nominally and 100→40→10 after the change. Reject both a negative balance and the lost-update history where two successful 60-unit debits leave 40. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 兩個交易讀到同一餘額並各自寫回會造成 lost update；本課用教學帳本示範衝突後重新讀取與應用層冪等鍵。
knowledge.textEn: Two transactions reading the same balance can create a lost update if their independent writes are accepted without conflict handling. Use a teaching ledger to study rereading after conflict and application-level idempotency keys.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 事件表包含 transaction_id、read_version、requested_debit、commit_status 與 balance_after；另保留已完成冪等鍵集合。
knowledge.textEn: Record transaction identity, read version, requested debit, commit status and balance after each event. Maintain a separate set of completed idempotency keys so retried delivery cannot apply one debit twice.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 帳本規則為餘額不可負，交易需基於當前版本提交；衝突後須重讀再判斷，不可直接重送舊計算結果。
knowledge.textEn: Require nonnegative balance and submission against the current version. After conflict, reread and reevaluate the business rule rather than resubmitting a value calculated from a stale snapshot.

steps.title: DAOS transaction：建立可追溯輸入與所有權 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: DAOS transactions: construct traceable inputs and ownership · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「DAOS transaction：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for DAOS transactions: construct traceable inputs and ownership and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付可重播交易 JSON、衝突與拒絕軌跡、冪等重送測例及 40/10 單位核算。
在交接件中加入「DAOS transaction：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：逐事件核對版本遞增與餘額 100→40，變更 100→40→10；名義不得產生 -20 或兩筆都成功但仍為 40；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：事件表包含 transaction_id、read_version、requested_debit、commit_status 與 balance_after；另保留已完成冪等鍵集合。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver replayable transaction JSON, conflict and rejection traces, idempotent redelivery tests and the 40/10 calculations. Keep the model entirely local and label its application-specific balance rule.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for DAOS transactions: construct traceable inputs and ownership: Replay events and verify 100→40 nominally and 100→40→10 after the change. Reject both a negative balance and the lost-update history where two successful 60-unit debits leave 40. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Record transaction identity, read version, requested debit, commit status and balance after each event. Maintain a separate set of completed idempotency keys so retried delivery cannot apply one debit twice. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。逐事件核對版本遞增與餘額 100→40，變更 100→40→10；名義不得產生 -20 或兩筆都成功但仍為 40；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。

Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.

Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
